SPECIFICATION FOR 

FORCEPS, BONE CUTTING, STRAIGHT AND 

ANGULAR, LISTON'S PATTERN 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for Liston's pattern straight and angular bone cutting 
forceps used in orthopaedic surgery.

4. Workmanship 

4.1 The forceps shall be free from rough edges, pits, bur^, cracks and grinding marks, 

4.2 The cutting edges shall be sharp and uniform and shall be free from nicks, waviness and jags. 

4.3 When the jaws are closed, the cutting edges shall meet evenly throughout their length. 

4.4 The joint shall have no undue play. 

4.5 The spring action shall be smooth. It shall be neither too slack nor too hard. 

5. Heat Treatment — The arms shall be hardened and tempered to 520 to 600 HV, the spring leaves 
to 380 to A20HV and the rivet to 290 to 320 HV. 

6. Finish — The forceps shall be finished smooth and passivated. The polishing shall be done in 
accordance with the choice of the consumer. 

7. Tests 

7.1 Performance Test — Cut a piece of rib of a fully grown goat or sheep five times with the instrument. 
Each time the instrument shall cut the rib evenly in one bite without any undue resistance, and the 
cutting edges shall not show any sign of damage. 

7.2 Load Closure fes/ — Apply a compressive force of 15 ± 2 N at the ends of the handles. The 
cutting edges shall meet evenly throughout their length on the application of the force. 

7.3 Corrosion Resistance Test — Scrub the instrument with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water 
and then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the instrument, immerse in copper sulphate solution at 
room temperature for 6 minutes and wash with fresh water or wet cotton wool. 

The composition of the copper sjjiphate solution shall be as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuS04.5HjO ) 40 g 

Sulphuric acid ( H2SO4 ) ( sp gr 1 "84 ) 1 0*0 g 

Distilled water [see 15:1070-1960 90*0 ml 

Specification for water, distilled 
quality ( revised)] 

There shall be no red stains or spots on the instrument, but dulling of the polished surface may 
be permitted. 

8. IMarking — The forceps shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words ' Stainless Steel '. 

8.1 ISI Certification IMarking — DeXaWs available with the Indian Standards Institution, 

9. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
